decisions.reason: As a close fit with the firm's geospatial-enterprise integration direction and now given its own page, management is likely to continue backing it rather than admit a recent initiative was premature.

Although its website presence remains modest, the framework is close to the core open and extensible GeoIT offering, so management is still more likely to persist than to write off the effort quickly.
This service has the strongest visible public commitment through explicit launch messaging and a dedicated page, making management especially likely to stay committed despite any early uncertainty.

The workshop is new, prominently presented, and well aligned with the firm's consulting and training strengths, so management will probably keep it on the market at least another year while giving it time to gain traction.
